summary.text: Ben Adams represents Idaho Senate District 12 and lives in Nampa; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term and one earlier term in the House (2020-2022).

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says Adams was born in Jupiter, Florida, was raised in Kiev, Ukraine, and in Emmett, Idaho, and studied at Boise State University.
The biography describes Adams as a retired Marine Corps sergeant who served two combat tours in Afghanistan.
